title: sorbus aria subsp. salicifolia
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. salicifolia, commonly known as Whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the stimulation of the immune system, reduction of inflammation, and improvement of digestive health. The therapeutic actions attributed to Whitebeam include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents of Whitebeam include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal effects.
